correctness.rationale: In characteristic 2, involution cancellation makes every off-diagonal determinant variable occur with even exponent, so partial derivatives are exactly diagonal cofactors. On det=0 the adjugate rank-1 formula at corank one forces a nonzero diagonal cofactor, while all cofactors vanish at corank≥2; support equals the reduced corank-two locus. On a rank-(n-2) Schur chart detM=detA(uv+w²); the exact hypersurface Jacobian quotient is (u,v,w²), yielding a square-zero rank-one nilradical and generic length two. Under kernel frame G the residual w transforms by detG (char2), and projective scaling supplies O(-1), identifying detK⊗O(-1). At corank one gradients are λ(v_i²) in diagonal slots, giving the kernel-line map followed by Frobenius with image the entire diagonal P^{n-1}. Independently exhaustively checked all 1,024 symmetric binary 4×4 and 32,768 symmetric binary 5×5 matrices: support/adjugate gradient and corank-one vector identities agreed. All-n proof uses Schur algebra, not finite extrapolation.
